children: is gaining momentum after a sharp post-CPI move pushed ETH toward $2,667, putting the $2,700–$2,800 region back in focus. The rally has also been accompanied by a nearly 14% rise in transactions above $1 million, pointing to heavier whale activity as volatility returns. With institutional flows adding another layer to the setup, traders are now watching whether ETH can hold its breakout structure and extend the recovery, or whether profit-taking turns the latest surge into another short-lived move.
Whale Activity Accelerates as CPI Triggers ETH Repricing

Ethereum’s latest move came with a notable jump in large-holder activity. Transactions above $1 million rose nearly 14% as ETH surged following the U.S. CPI release, while roughly $250 million in ETH shorts were liquidated during the surge.

The August CPI report showed headline inflation at 3.4% year over year, with core CPI at 2.4%, giving risk assets room to rally without a major inflation surprise. ETH climbed from roughly $2,433 to $2,667 in the move. The key signal now is whether elevated whale activity persists after the CPI-driven volatility fades. Continued large-wallet participation would add credibility to the breakout; a quick reversal would suggest the move was driven more by short covering than fresh demand.
ETH Price Analysis: Bulls Need to Clear the Next Supply Zone

Ethereum price chart showed a recovery from a prolonged consolidation before accelerating higher. The breakout pushed ETH through the upper portion of its recent range and briefly carried the token toward $2,667. The next major supply area sits around $2,700–$2,800. A decisive move through that region would strengthen the breakout structure and bring $3,000 back into the picture.

The $2,500 area is now the key near-term reference on a pullback. Holding above it would preserve the recent recovery structure, while a deeper decline back into the previous range would weaken the breakout thesis. Momentum has improved substantially, but ETH has also moved quickly. A period of consolidation after the CPI-driven surge would therefore be constructive if buyers continue defending the breakout rather than allowing the entire move to unwind.

Ethereum’s latest move has been driven by a clear market catalyst rather than a random price spike. CPI data triggered the initial repricing, short liquidations accelerated the advance, and rising large-value transactions showed that whale activity increased alongside the move. Institutional flows remain another variable to watch as ETH approaches heavier resistance.

The next phase will determine the quality of the breakout. Holding the higher range would keep the recovery intact; sustained selling would signal that Friday’s surge was largely a positioning event rather than the start of a lasting trend.

title: Ethereum Price Momentum Builds as $1M+ Whale Transactions Surge
